definitions.explanation: A literary work expressing feelings and ideas in verse.

examples.japanese: この{詩|し}は{美|うつく}しい。

notes:
{詩|し} refers to poetry in general.

TYPES OF POETRY:
- {俳句|はいく}: haiku
- {短歌|たんか}: tanka
- {漢詩|かんし}: Chinese poetry
- {現代詩|げんだいし}: modern poetry

RELATED:
- {詩人|しじん}: poet
- {詩集|ししゅう}: poetry collection
